rules.title: No gradient text
rules.fix: Use a flat text token. Carry emphasis with size, weight or position, and allow one accent word at most.
rules.why: Gradient text fakes hierarchy with decoration and is the most copied tell of a generated page.

rules.title: No gradients on controls or text
rules.fix: Fill with a flat token. If the gradient was separating a region, separate it with spacing, a hairline or a surface tint.
rules.why: A gradient on a control is decoration standing in for a decision about emphasis.

rules.title: No indigo to violet gradient
rules.fix: Take the colour from the project palette and drop the gradient.
rules.why: The indigo to violet sweep is the single most recognisable default of generated interfaces.

rules.title: No glassmorphism without real content behind it
rules.fix: Delete the blur layer. Separate the surface with spacing, a hairline, a tint or a card.
rules.why: Frosted glass over an empty background blurs nothing and only signals polish.

rules.title: No blurred orbs, spotlights or grain layers
rules.fix: Delete the layer. If the page needs depth, use the project's elevation token.
rules.why: Ambient blobs and grain are atmosphere with no information in it.

rules.title: No coloured or glowing shadows
rules.fix: Use the project's elevation token. Show focus with the focus ring and attention with hierarchy.
rules.why: A shadow with no offset is a glow, and a glow signals emphasis nobody chose.

rules.title: No pure black and pure white pair
rules.fix: Take both roles from the project's text and surface tokens.
rules.why: Pure black on pure white is a default value, and it reads as harsh against every tinted token around it.

rules.title: Hard block shadow only in a neobrutalist world
rules.fix: Use the project's elevation token. Keep a block shadow only where the product chose neobrutalism and says so in Phase 0.
rules.why: A 4px 4px 0 shadow imports a whole visual style without anyone deciding to.

rules.title: No blob or clip-path shape standing in for a cut-out
rules.fix: Use a real cut-out asset of the subject, or a plain rectangle.
rules.why: A random organic mask pretends the image was art directed.

rules.title: No cream-paper default

detect.how: Look for a cream page with a thin serif, an italic accent and pill buttons. Ask whether the product's world picked them or nothing was decided.

rules.fix: Name the product's world in Phase 0 and take palette and type from it. Without one, use the system's neutral tokens.
rules.why: Cream paper is the current statistical median of a designed look.

rules.title: Secondary text on a coloured surface is tinted from it

detect.how: On every coloured surface, check that secondary text is a tint of that surface and not a neutral grey.

rules.fix: Derive the secondary role from the surface colour.
rules.why: Neutral grey on a coloured surface looks pasted on and loses contrast unevenly.

rules.title: Only the declared families and scale

detect.how: Compare every font family and size in the diff against the project's declared type tokens.

rules.fix: Use the nearest declared style. Express emphasis as a weight step, not a new size.
rules.why: A new font or one-off size is a value invented at emission time that the next generation will not repeat.

rules.title: No blanket tracking-tight
rules.fix: Remove it, or set tracking per style in the type scale.
rules.why: Applied everywhere, tight tracking is a reflex and not a decision about any one style.

rules.title: No italic-serif accent words
rules.fix: Carry emphasis with weight or size in the project's face.
rules.why: An italic serif word inside a sans heading is the second most copied accent device.

rules.title: Hierarchy is size and weight, not decoration

detect.how: For each heading and label, check that rank comes from size or weight and not from colour, underline, badge or effect.

rules.fix: Move rank onto the type scale.
rules.why: Decoration faking hierarchy is one of the four root causes of slop.

rules.title: No eyebrow

detect.how: Delete any short inert line before a heading, in any geometry, and reread the section. If only a name for what follows was lost, it was an eyebrow. Figcaptions, th, labels, bylines, time and units are not eyebrows.

rules.fix: Delete it. A lost fact becomes the heading, a caption or a th.
rules.why: An eyebrow labels what the heading already says.

rules.title: No tracked-caps label
rules.fix: Set body-face labels one step smaller, sentence case, untracked.
rules.why: Small tracked capitals are the stock look of a label with nothing to say. A wordmark is excepted.

rules.title: No text under 12px
rules.fix: Take the size from the type scale's smallest legible step.
rules.why: Text under 12px fails readers before it fails any contrast check.

rules.title: Headings in outline order with a visible step between levels
rules.fix: Re-level headings to the page outline. Make each level one scale step or one weight step from the next.
rules.why: A skipped level or a flat scale removes the structure the headings exist to give.

rules.title: Body measure 75ch at most
rules.fix: Set max-width in ch on the text block.
rules.why: Lines past about 75 characters lose the reader's place.

rules.title: Body leading 1.4 or more
rules.fix: Take line-height from the type scale's body step.
rules.why: Tight leading in running text blocks the eye from finding the next line.

rules.title: No justified or all-caps running text
rules.fix: Left-align running text and keep capitals to short labels.
rules.why: Justified and all-caps paragraphs open rivers of space and slow reading.

rules.title: Display type 6rem at most, tracking no tighter than -0.04em
rules.fix: Use the display step of the type scale.
rules.why: Oversized, crushed headlines are a poster costume on a product screen.

rules.title: Monospace only for code, data and measurement

detect.how: Find every monospace run and check it holds code, data or a measurement.

rules.fix: Use the body face and tabular numerals where alignment matters.
rules.why: Monospace as a technical costume signals a theme, not content.

rules.title: Container nesting at most one deep

detect.how: Count bordered or filled containers inside bordered or filled containers. More than one level is a violation.

rules.fix: Dissolve the inner boundaries down the ladder and keep the content.
rules.why: A card inside a card shows the page was assembled rather than structured.

rules.title: Separation ladder

detect.how: Check that each separation uses the lightest device that works: spacing, then hairline, then surface tint, then card.

rules.fix: Step down the ladder until the grouping still reads.
rules.why: Reaching for a card first turns every group into a box.

rules.title: Radii and gaps only from the project's scale

detect.how: Compare every radius and gap in the diff to the project's scale tokens.

rules.fix: Snap to the nearest scale step.
rules.why: Off-scale values drift with each generation.

rules.title: No exactly-three-equal-cards reflex
rules.fix: Rank the content. Give the answering item the dominant cell and move the rest to a row or table.
rules.why: Three equal cards are the default shape of content nobody ranked.

rules.title: No identical stat-card strips

detect.how: Look for a row of same-sized cards each holding a number and a label.

rules.fix: Rank the stats. Lead with the one that answers the screen's question and demote the rest.
rules.why: A strip of equal stats ranks nothing.

rules.title: No bento mosaic of same-sized cells

detect.how: Look for a grid where every cell has the same size and weight.

rules.fix: Size cells by the importance of their content.
rules.why: A bento with uniform cells keeps the look and loses the point.

rules.title: No hero-metric block standing in for a headline

detect.how: Look for a big number with a small label and supporting stats where a headline belongs.

rules.fix: Lead with the real headline. A number gets size only as the answer to the screen's question.
rules.why: A hero metric is a template layout filled with invented weight.

rules.title: No section numbers unless order is information
rules.fix: Remove the ordinals, or keep them where the order matters.
rules.why: 01 / 02 / 03 decorates sections that have no sequence.

rules.title: No modal for a task that neither interrupts nor needs locked focus

detect.how: For each modal, check the task interrupts the user or needs focus locked. If not, it belongs inline or in a panel.

rules.fix: Move the task inline or into a panel.
rules.why: A modal takes the whole screen for something that did not need it.

rules.title: The most important element is visibly dominant

detect.how: Squint at the screen: one element should win, and sections should not share one anatomy.

rules.fix: Rank the content and make one element larger, heavier or higher than the rest.
rules.why: Equal weight everywhere means no hierarchy was decided.

rules.title: More space above a heading than below it

detect.how: Measure the space above and below each heading; above must be larger.

rules.fix: Raise the space above or lower the space below, from the spacing scale.
rules.why: A heading closer to its content than to the previous block reads as belonging to it.

rules.title: Text and cards stay off the screen edge
rules.fix: Add a gutter from the spacing scale, 16px at 375 at least.
rules.why: Text touching the screen edge reads as clipped.

rules.title: Padding inside a bordered or filled box is from the spacing scale

detect.how: Check each bordered or filled box for padding taken from the scale and not squeezed against its text.

rules.fix: Use a spacing-scale step for the padding.
rules.why: Cramped boxes make a screen feel unfinished.

rules.title: No default dashboard shell

detect.how: Ask what the screen's job is and the one decision the user makes on it. A shell of sidebar, top bar, four stat cards, chart and table chosen first is a hit.

rules.fix: Name the job and the decision. The deciding list or table is the page and the stat row is a footnote or gone.
rules.why: The default shell is picked before anyone knows what the screen is for.

rules.title: Layout does not move on state change
rules.fix: Reserve the space at rest, with invisible or opacity-0 or the same border in transparent. Put the signal on colour, shadow, ring or opacity.
rules.why: A box that shifts on hover or focus makes the page jump under the pointer.

rules.title: No raw colour values where tokens exist
rules.fix: Use the project's token matched by usage. If none fits, propose a token and do not inline a value.
rules.why: A raw value is a colour decided at emission time that will drift.

rules.title: No arbitrary pixel values
rules.fix: Snap to the nearest step of the project's scale.
rules.why: Arbitrary values escape the scale and multiply.

rules.title: Counts stay inside the scale

detect.how: Count distinct font sizes (7 at most), radii and shadows (a subset of the project's scale) and saturated accents (1 per viewport).

rules.fix: Converge onto existing steps.
rules.why: A count that grows shows decisions being remade each generation.

rules.title: Ratchet: distinct radii, shadows and sizes did not grow

detect.how: Compare the number of distinct radii, shadows and sizes before and after the change.

rules.fix: Converge onto existing steps. New steps enter through the token system only.
rules.why: A ratchet that only turns one way keeps drift visible.

rules.title: Compose from the project's library

detect.how: Search the library before creating a component. Flag any new component that duplicates an existing one, such as a V2.

rules.fix: Delete the new one and extend the existing one through its variant props.
rules.why: Duplicate components are per-emission amnesia made visible.

rules.title: No coloured left-border accent strip
rules.fix: Dissolve the strip. If it carries meaning, give that meaning a word or an icon.
rules.why: A coloured edge on a callout is a decoration standing in for a label.

rules.title: No icon in a tinted rounded tile above a heading

detect.how: Look for a small icon in a tinted rounded square directly above a heading.

rules.fix: Delete the tile. Lead with the heading, or set the icon inline at its normal size.
rules.why: The tile is the stock opener of generated feature cards.

rules.title: No AI-powered badge theater
rules.fix: State what the feature does in a plain sentence.
rules.why: A badge about the technology tells the reader nothing about the product.

rules.title: No unlabeled sparkle icons
rules.fix: Use the project's icon for the action, with an accessible name, or nothing.
rules.why: A sparkle replaces the name of the feature with a mood.

rules.title: Every control does something

detect.how: Trace each form, link and button to a handler or a destination. A form that prints Sent without a request, or a link to nowhere, is a hit.

rules.fix: Validate and post nowhere, and say on screen that nothing was sent. Remove the dead link or label it Coming soon.
rules.why: A control that appears to work invents an outcome.

rules.title: One filled control per view

detect.how: Count filled controls in the viewport. More than one is a hit.

rules.fix: Demote the others to outlined or plain.
rules.why: One solid shape marks the way forward.

rules.title: One icon library, one weight, two or three sizes

detect.how: List the icon sources, stroke weights and sizes in the diff.

rules.fix: Use the project's icon set at its sizes, or nothing.
rules.why: Mixed sets make the interface look stitched together.

rules.title: No emoji in chrome
rules.fix: Use the project icon set at its sizes, or nothing.
rules.why: Emoji render differently on every platform and read as filler.

rules.title: No idle loops
rules.fix: Bind the motion to a real state change or render it static.
rules.why: Motion that runs on an idle page asks for attention with nothing to say.

rules.title: No scroll-reveal, marquee, typewriter or parallax
rules.fix: Render the content static. Use a named transition for a real state change.
rules.why: These effects are a catalogue of motion tricks, each unrelated to what the screen does.

rules.title: Never transition all
rules.fix: Name the properties and use ease-out.
rules.why: transition all animates properties nobody meant to animate.

rules.title: Transition transform and opacity only
rules.fix: Animate transform or opacity.
rules.why: Layout properties force reflow on every frame.

rules.title: A prefers-reduced-motion guard wherever keyframes exist
rules.fix: Add a reduced-motion override that disables or shortens the animation.
rules.why: Motion without a guard ignores a setting the user already made.

rules.title: Nothing hidden at rest
rules.fix: Keep it visible by default. Hide under a .js class only, or animate from visible with @starting-style.
rules.why: A reveal class that waits for a script ships a blank page when the script fails.

rules.title: Interval and frame loops run only while visible
rules.fix: Gate the loop on document.hidden or the view's own active flag.
rules.why: A loop that runs in a hidden view burns battery and does nothing.

rules.title: No animate- classes outside sanctioned loaders
rules.fix: Bind the animation to a state change, or remove it. Loaders named in Phase 0 are exempt.
rules.why: Stock animate- utilities are the usual source of idle motion.

rules.title: Verb and object labels
rules.fix: Say what the control does, with a verb and an object.
rules.why: A generic label hides the action behind it.

rules.title: No banned register
rules.fix: Say what the thing does in a plain sentence. Delete an unprovable adjective.
rules.why: These words make a claim the interface cannot back.

rules.title: No not-just-X-it's-Y construction
rules.fix: State the positive claim directly.
rules.why: The construction is a recognised model rhythm and it hedges.

rules.title: No exclamation marks in microcopy
rules.fix: End the sentence with a full stop, or report the result.
rules.why: Enthusiasm in microcopy is cheerleading.

rules.title: No aphoristic cadence
rules.fix: Write one plain sentence with a verb that says what the thing does.
rules.why: A run of short fragments stands in for a sentence.

rules.title: No cheerleading or celebration for a routine action
rules.fix: State the result plainly with the next small action. A celebration becomes the result plus Undo.
rules.why: The interface should report what happened and not applaud.

rules.title: No fabricated numbers, names, quotes, logos or demo data

detect.how: Check every number, name, quote, logo and row against a real source. Anything no real system could emit is a hit.

rules.fix: Delete the claim or use an honest placeholder that names what goes there.
rules.why: Fabrication pressure is one of the four root causes of slop.

rules.title: No middle-dot meta strings
rules.fix: Use line breaks, columns or hairlines. A single dot in a byline is fine.
rules.why: Dot-joined strings are a template for metadata nobody structured.

rules.title: No arrow glued to link or button text
rules.fix: Use a verb as the label. The arrow adds nothing.
rules.why: Learn more with an arrow is the stock call to action.

rules.title: No decorative status dot before a label

detect.how: Check each dot before a label. A dot that marks a live state is legal; a decorative one is a hit.

rules.fix: Remove the dot, or tie it to a real state.
rules.why: A dot with no state behind it implies liveness that is not there.

rules.title: No filler people

detect.pattern: John Doe|Jane Doe|johndoe@|Sarah Chen|Jane Smith|John Smith|Lorem ipsum

rules.fix: Leave the cell empty or use an honest placeholder such as Your name.
rules.why: Invented people make the data look real and are not.

rules.title: Project chart palette only
rules.fix: Take series colours from the project palette. Use a plain line with direct labels.
rules.why: These are the library defaults every generated chart shares.

rules.title: Linear or step interpolation
rules.fix: Use linear or step.
rules.why: A smoothed curve draws values that were never measured.

rules.title: No gradient area fills
rules.fix: Fill with a flat token at a fixed opacity, or no fill.
rules.why: A gradient under a line is decoration.

rules.title: Flat marks

detect.how: Check chart marks for shadows, glows, 3D and rounded caps that carry no data.

rules.fix: Draw plain flat marks.
rules.why: Effects on marks compete with the data.

rules.title: Units visible

detect.how: Check that every axis, value and legend shows its unit.

rules.fix: Add the unit to the axis label or value.
rules.why: A number without a unit cannot be read.

rules.title: Bars are zero-based

detect.how: Check each bar chart's axis starts at zero.

rules.fix: Start the axis at zero, or use a different mark.
rules.why: A truncated bar axis misstates the ratio between bars.

rules.title: Fewer than four data points is a stat, not a chart

detect.how: Count the data points in each chart.

rules.fix: Show a stat with its comparison.
rules.why: A chart of three points shows less than the three numbers.

rules.title: The chart title is the question it answers
rules.fix: Write the question, such as Failed jobs per hour, last 24h.
rules.why: A generic title leaves the reader to guess the chart's job.

rules.title: A delta needs a named comparison period

detect.how: Check every change figure such as +12% names what it compares against and over what period.

rules.fix: Name the comparison or delete the delta.
rules.why: An unanchored delta is an invented claim.

rules.title: One channel, one variable

detect.how: Check that colour, length, position and size each encode one thing.

rules.fix: Give the second variable its own channel: position, length or a label.
rules.why: A mark whose colour and length mean different things asks the reader to decode two scales at once.

rules.title: Empty, loading, error and populated states are all designed

detect.how: Render each of the four states for every data-driven view.

rules.fix: Empty is a sentence plus the creating action, loading a matched skeleton, error a cause plus retry.
rules.why: A happy-path-only screen breaks on the first real day.

rules.title: Anything that fetches carries an honest offline or stale tell

detect.how: Check each fetching view for a visible offline or stale indicator and no mock data shown as live.

rules.fix: Add the offline or stale tell. Never fall back silently.
rules.why: Fallback data rendered as live is fabrication.

rules.title: Visible focus on everything interactive
rules.fix: Add a visible focus style from the project's ring token.
rules.why: Keyboard users cannot see where they are without it.

rules.title: AA contrast on the actual surface in every theme
rules.fix: Move up the text ramp or lighten the surface. Do not use a one-off darker hex.
rules.why: Contrast read against the real pixels is what the eye sees.

rules.title: A surface that keeps its colour in both themes keeps its text roles

detect.how: Check surfaces that do not flip with the theme. Their text must not invert against them.

rules.fix: Read roles that do not invert for that surface.
rules.why: Inverting text on a fixed surface fails in one theme.

rules.title: Never colour alone

detect.how: Check each state carried by colour, such as overdue, failed or over budget, also carries a word, icon, shape or position.

rules.fix: Add the word, icon, shape or position. Keep the colour as reinforcement.
rules.why: Colour-only state fails colour-blind users and greyscale prints.

rules.title: Themes flip tokens, not components

detect.how: Check dark mode is the same component reading flipped roles and not a forked variant.

rules.fix: Read one component against role tokens.
rules.why: Forked dark variants drift apart.

rules.title: Semantic elements, no onClick divs
rules.fix: Use a button or a link.
rules.why: A div with a click handler has no keyboard behaviour or role.

rules.title: Accessible names on icon buttons

detect.how: Check each icon-only button has an accessible name.

rules.fix: Add aria-label or visible text, and a tooltip for sighted users.
rules.why: An icon without a name is silent to a screen reader.

rules.title: No broken image on load
rules.fix: Fix the path. An image that may be missing gets a sized placeholder and alt text.
rules.why: A broken image is the first thing the eye catches.

rules.title: No uncaught script error on load
rules.fix: Fix the error.
rules.why: An uncaught error means part of the page may not run.

rules.title: Chrome states are designed and checked

detect.how: Render every collapsed, compact and truncating mode and look at a screenshot. Check truncation is decided for the whole tree.

rules.fix: Design the collapsed mode as its own state. Icons keep labels as tooltips or accessible names.
rules.why: A clipped focus ring passes the DOM check and fails the eye.

rules.title: Browser surfaces are themed

detect.how: Check selection colour, caret, scrollbar and tabular numerals are set and not left at browser defaults.

rules.fix: Set accent-color, caret-color, ::selection, scrollbar styling and tabular numerals from the tokens.
rules.why: Default browser surfaces are the cheapest tell of an assembled page.

rules.title: Hostile fixtures

detect.how: Run the screen against the worst real day, 3x strings, a one-letter name, a count of one, missing fields, diacritics, empty, error, offline, mixed-sign data, 200% zoom, 40% longer labels, one 40-character token, a right-to-left run and another locale's number and date format.

rules.fix: Design for the worst real day and fix what breaks.
rules.why: The demo's good day hides the failures real data shows.

rules.title: No horizontal scroll at 375px
rules.fix: Use mobile-first bases and let content wrap or scroll inside its own container.
rules.why: Sideways scroll on a phone breaks the page.

rules.title: Tap targets of at least 24px, 44px in sticky bars
rules.fix: Pad the hit area.
rules.why: Small targets cause mis-taps.

rules.title: No hover-only actions

detect.how: Check every action revealed on hover is also reachable by focus and on touch.

rules.fix: Show the action at rest, or add a kebab menu.
rules.why: Touch has no hover.

rules.title: Tables get a small-screen strategy

detect.how: Check each table at 375px for a stacked, scrolling or reduced layout.

rules.fix: Choose a strategy: stacked rows, horizontal scroll in a container, or fewer columns.
rules.why: A table at 375px otherwise overflows.

rules.title: dvh, not vh, for shells
rules.fix: Use dvh.
rules.why: vh ignores the mobile browser toolbar and overflows.
